newsitem.title: USA: Conrail seeks higher bid from CSX.
newsitem.headline: Conrail seeks higher bid from CSX.

text.p: Conrail Inc. said Monday it would negotiate a higher offer from planned merger partner CSX Corp. so that Conrail shareholders would get $115 a share, which would equal a rival bid from Norfolk Southern Corp.

The board has authorised management and its representatives "to negotiate amendments to the CSX merger agreement that would assure that the Conrail shareholders receive $115 in cash per share at the earliest possible date," the company said in a statement.

The statement appeared to confirm signs over the weekend that the four-month takeover battle for Conrail was nearing an end. Industry sources expect CSX to buy Conrail and then divide the assets with rival bidder Norfolk Southern.
